_about: John Spottiswoode (1565-1639), Archbishop of St Andrews: The History of the Church of Scotland, ed. Michael Russell and Mark Napier (Spottiswoode Society, Edinburgh: Oliver & Boyd, 1847-1851, 3 vols), from Princeton's copies, whose title pages carry the 1851 Oliver & Boyd imprint. The National Library of Scotland copies were swapped out on 2026-10-03 because NLS licenses its digital copies CC BY-NC-SA. An episcopal history of the Reformation in Scotland, the counterweight to Calderwood and Row. Volume numbers read off each title page. The surname check takes the spellings the edition uses. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.

spottiswoode-history-1: The History of the Church of Scotland, beginning the year of our Lord 203 and continued to the end of the reign of King James VI, ed. Russell and Napier (Spottiswoode Society; Edinburgh: Oliver & Boyd, 1851), vol. 1
